from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd(); r=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text()); ids=set(r['ids']); rows=[]
def wr(n,s):
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
base=p.parents[1]/'lanes/pi-mathdb-full-corpus-inventory-r301/corpus'
for f in sorted(base.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=f.read_bytes()
 for ln,raw in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):

  import base64
  z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'originals/{b["id"]}.jsonl','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(raw).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
